title: Compatible comparisons for a fixed ordinary evaluation chain map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] on $X$ and every open, let $K,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, and let $U$ be open. Write $R$ for restriction and $H$ for derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Let $P,F$ be complexes of $\mathcal O_U$-modules, with $P$ strictly perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and suppose given isomorphisms $RK\cong QP$ and $RN\cong QF$. Suppose given a chain map $f:T=\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,\mathcal O_U[0]))\to\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,F)$ satisfying the ordinary evaluation formula [lem-pc-strictly-perfect-ordinary-evaluation]. Put $D=H(K,\mathcal O_X[0])$, and let $g:N\otimes^L D\to H(K,N)$ be the canonical adjunct of the associator followed by $1_N\otimes\mathrm{ev}$ and the right unitor, for [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection] and [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. There exist compatible isomorphisms $a:R(N\otimes^L D)\cong QT$ and $b:RH(K,N)\cong Q\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,F)$ such that $R(g);b=a;Q(f)$. The complexes, representative isomorphisms and ordinary chain map are inputs, not objects asserted to exist.

proof.text: Restrict derived internal Hom to U and transport its arguments using the given representative isomorphisms. For a strictly perfect source P, Hom from each term is exact: the term is a retract of a finite free module and internal Hom preserves that retraction. The finite stupid filtration implies Hom(P,-) preserves the resolution quasi-isomorphism. Apply the bounded-exact-term Hom quasi-isomorphism theorem on the localized ringed site and compose its localized resolution isomorphism with the derived Hom factorization. This gives b directly for arbitrary U; no affineness hypothesis is introduced.

Apply the same computation to O_U[0]. The dual degree-q term is the dual of P^(-q); dualizing its finite-free retraction shows that it is finite projective and flat. The bounded dual is K-flat. Hence tensoring it with arbitrary F computes the derived tensor. Exact restriction and the given representative of N supply a, with symmetry used when the K-flat factor is second.

Uncurry the prescribed ordinary evaluation formula on every tensor summand. Evaluation and the unit action are natural with respect to F to I(F) and the dual resolution maps. The representative equation of the fixed canonical tensor-Hom family therefore gives the same chain map into the K-injective target. Localize this equality and transport through the given representatives and the restriction comparison. With a and b chosen in the preceding steps it is R(g);b=a;Q(f). This uses no invertibility of f and asserts no equality for arbitrary a or b.
